ValidationRule.description: User will not be able to update the First Bill Date and No Of Billing Months once Opportunity reached to Stage-5 ( Close-Won).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR(ISCHANGED( No_of_Forecast_Billing_Month__c),ISCHANGED( IM_Booked_Date__c )),
OR(ISPICKVAL( StageName , '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'7 - Closed')),
NOT(ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Renewal')),
Amount / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode)) >= 25000
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: First Bill Date OR No. of Billing Months Can't be updated Once Opportunity reached to Stage-5.
